Chapter 9: Navigating Tests, Games, and Manipulation
Not every relationship moment is simple or honest, right? Sometimes, people test boundaries, play subtle games, or even manipulate—often without realizing they're doing it. Being able to spot these patterns, and knowing how to handle them, is so important for protecting your self-respect.
You might notice a test when a partner cancels plans just to see how you'll react... or maybe they toss out a little comment that’s designed to make you jealous. The secret here? Respond with a calm confidence. Instead of getting anxious or overreacting, just hold steady.
Picture this: your partner flirts with someone else to get your attention. What do you do? Instead of begging for reassurance or trying to get even, you simply and calmly let them know what's okay—and what’s not. If it keeps happening, you might need to step back, or even walk away for good.
When it comes to manipulation, here are a few things to keep in mind:
- First, notice any patterns that make you feel uneasy or disrespected. - Next, talk about the issue directly. Leave out the drama or accusations. - Don’t get caught in tit-for-tat or mind games. - And most importantly, be willing to stick to your boundaries—even if that means taking a step back, or ending things entirely.
This takes both awareness and courage. It’s all about trusting your gut and refusing to get pulled into unhealthy cycles. Over time, this approach teaches people how to treat you—and it naturally pushes away anyone who isn’t willing to respect your boundaries.
